newsitem.title: UK: BZW appoints Nigel Rankine head of risk advisory.
newsitem.headline: BZW appoints Nigel Rankine head of risk advisory.

text.p: BZW said on Wednesday that it appointed Nigel Rankine as a director and head of risk advisory, a new position in which he will advise corporate clients on risk management and currency issues associated with transactions.

Rankine joins BZW from Morgan Stanley in London where he held a similar role as investment banking currency adviser, BZW said in a statement. He joined Morgan Stanley in 1989 and had previously been a senior foreign exchange salesman and global head of currency options sales.
Between 1984 and 1989 he was FX sales manager at First National Bank of Chicago and he was a senior economist at Barclays between 1979 and 1984.
